primary_population: Legally confirmed age-14 Balanced wings, 195 creation AP, high-school rule profile; all teammates and opponents legally confirmed freshmen
contexts: Full factorial: utility_energy/shooter role x balanced/spacing teammate composition x perimeter/rim opponent specialists (8 cells); same Starter rotation intent and controlled slot within family
pairing: AB BA BA AB; subject opens in phases 0 and 1, opponent in 2 and 3. Every subject has all four venue/opener assignments per quartet. A quartet uses the corrected CompetitionCatalog.population_roster_variations identity schedule, mapped onto freshly built legal freshman cohorts, without altering existing team_for/population fixtures. Builds within a quartet share seeds, roster identities and match identity.
seed_formula: range_start + cell*1000 + quartet_index*4 + phase; simulation seed is variation+1; unique within each build and range, deliberately matched across builds
primary_comparisons: 17 primary equal-resource builds versus balanced_flat, pooled across the 8 predeclared cells. Secondary profile and family arms stay separate. All other pairwise comparisons and individual-cell outcomes are exploratory.
raw_observables: All box-score counts, exact seconds, completed passes, screens/advantages, touches, on-court offensive/defensive terminal-possession exposures, team possessions/scores/wins; on-court exposure is assessed at possession start and terminal separately and its limits are reported
uncertainty: Matched quartet ratio influences, not independent player events or individual games. 95% Student-t intervals over quartet influence differences, conditional on the fixed roster/context schedule and repeatedly used generated player identities. Zero empirical variance and fewer than 8 quartet clusters yield unavailable intervals. Cells have n=2 and no inferential verdict. Familywise Bonferroni intervals cover 17*11*2=374 primary comparisons across both untouched ranges; pooled n=16 per build/range. This asymptotic small-sample method cannot establish mature population coverage.
practical_effect_interpretation: No locked minimum practical effect exists for between-build dominance. Every comparison reports native-unit effects, count equivalents per32minutes/100opportunities, observed raw counts and intervals. Meaningful practical advantage remains unclassified unless an applicable locked minimum exists; none is supplied for these contrasts. Positive simultaneous intervals alone do not establish meaningful superiority. No effect magnitude becomes a new pass band.
dominance_interpretation: A descriptive Pareto frontier uses eleven individual primary means (turnovers and allowed eFG reversed); it is finite-portfolio descriptive evidence. Statistical local superiority requires all eleven simultaneous intervals favor the same build in each untouched range, but practical meaning remains owner interpretation. A demonstrated universal guardrail violation additionally requires every predeclared role/lineup/matchup cell and comparisons across alternatives; the present cell sample cannot support that. Nonsignificance never establishes equivalence or absence of a dominant legal build.
search_separation: Portfolio fixed from capabilities/specifications before exploration. Exploration validates instruments and shows candidate patterns; no candidates or settings selected from its outcomes. Confirmation code, portfolio and protocol hashes are retained; no retuning or desired-verdict loop.
scope_limits: No higher-competition extension, career profile fairness, mature-world rarity, full legal-space exhaustion, nightly/deep proof, or section 27.1 certification. Maturity fixed Average; 2/11 tactical roles and a tiny fraction of 5^10 tendency configurations are sampled.
